messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
On what date was the EC declaration of conformity of the complete robot cell (the final machine into which the UR5e and UR10e arms are integrated) drawn up?

response.text: {"lookups": ["EU Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC Annex II.1.A EC declaration of conformity \"drawn up\" date robot cell \"dichiarazione CE di conformità\" \"redatta\" macchina completa", "UR5e UR10e \"partly completed machinery\" \"declaration of incorporation\" \"quasi-machine\" \"dichiarazione di incorporazione\" integrated into robot cell", "robot cell \"EC declaration of conformity\" \"date\" \"place\" \"signature\" final machine \"Universal Robots\" integrator \"dichiarazione CE\" \"data\" cella robotizzata", "D.Lgs. 81/2008 Allegato V attrezzature di lavoro \"dichiarazione CE di conformità\" \"cella robotizzata\" UR5e UR10e \"data di redazione\""]}
